  cases h with

  | read z admininstr_lst admininstr'_lst =>

  | ctxt_label z v_n instr_0_lst admininstr_lst z' admininstr'_lst =>

      | config_case_0 _ _ hst' hais' =>

  | ctxt_frame s f v_n f' admininstr_lst s' f'' admininstr'_lst =>

theorem iswf_fun_growmemory_pages_lt {mi : meminst} {k : Nat} {o : Option meminst}
    (h : fun_growmemory mi k o) (hne : o ≠ none) :
    rat_to_nat (((List.length mi.BYTES) : Rat) / ((64 * Ki) : Rat)) < 2 ^ 32 := by
  cases h with
  | fun_growmemory_case_1 => exact absurd rfl hne
  | fun_growmemory_case_0 =>
    subst_vars
    exact iswf_grow_pages _ _ ‹_ ≤ ((2 ^ 16) : Rat)›
